g.text: Hybrid GDN + full / sparse attention + MoE | Example: CP = TP = 4
Scheduler builds token / slot / layout plans
Pack read-only metadata and upload before forward
Pack prefix + preserve fresh BF16 KV
MoE / MLP consumes valid token rows
Optional Mega combine writes the next layer's destination layout
Hidden states and residuals follow the same token mapping
Full-attention KV ring, QSA index-key ring, GDN state and expert communication are distinct.
